_doc: Provenance allowlist for the banned-pattern guard (contract §2 'Guard exemption', d3 adjudication 2026-06-10). Each entry pins a DOCUMENTARY occurrence of a banned term — a comment or a data/JSON provenance string that NAMES the term while documenting its removal/history. An occurrence is exempt ONLY if its file matches AND the source line CONTAINS the entry's `anchor` (a deterministic static substring, no per-instance discretion). The same token operating as a LIVE MECHANISM lands on a line without the anchor and is NEVER exempt. This list is reviewed/Overwatch-signed; adding an entry is a deliberate, visible act. Editing frozen 021 data to delete a historical word is forbidden (cosmetic gaming), which is why these stay and are allowlisted instead.
